summary.text: Michael Alfonso is the Republican nominee for the open 7th District. He says he was raised in Vilas County and Wausau, studied mathematics at the University of Wisconsin-Madison, worked in construction and concrete, and produced The Dan Bongino Show podcast. He has not held elected office; he won the August 2026 Republican primary with President Trump's endorsement.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, raised in Vilas County and Wausau, Wisconsin; his grandparents fled Cuba at the end of the Castro Revolution.
Paid his own way through the University of Wisconsin-Madison by working in construction, and earned a Bachelor of Science in mathematics.
Married Evita Duffy at 22 and began married life in Hayward, Wisconsin, returning to the construction and concrete industry; per his campaign website.
About a year later became producer of The Dan Bongino Show podcast, according to his campaign website.
Has not held elected office. Endorsed by President Trump in the Republican primary; his father-in-law, Sean Duffy, held the 7th District seat until 2019.
Won the August 11, 2026 Republican primary with 48.9% of the vote over Kevin Hermening and others; if elected, he would be the youngest member of Congress, according to WXPR.

sources.title: Alfonso wins Republican primary for 7th Congressional District seat
